ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Tender and estimate, Clarification and later stages need Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Tender_estimate", CASE(StageName, "Opportunity", 1, "Go or no-go", 2, "Estimating", 3, "Bid submitted", 4, "Clarification", 5, "Preferred bidder", 6, "Awarded", 7, 0) >= 5, ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Next step date before moving to Clarification.
